claim: Molasses thickens dramatically as it cools; the spilled molasses cooled rapidly in the January air (Harvard team: Nicole Sharp, Jordan Kennedy, Shmuel Rubinstein, APS fluid-dynamics meeting, Nov 2016), with viscosity up by a factor of four or more by Sharp's estimate.
